SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special Branch Station, H.O.
REPORT
Date August 30, 1940.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTRY File No 337）

Subject Radio Transmitting at House 442 to 450 Hart Road.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan

Reference the attached letter from the
U.S.M.C. regarding the erection of a radio antenna
on the roof of a building from Nos. 442 to 450
Hart Road, observation shows that the antenna
is supported by bamboo posts about 15 feet above
the top of the building, with two lead-in wires
in the middle of the aerial, twisted together and
connected to House 446 Hart Road. Information
obtained is to the effect that the antenna is of
the kind used for ordinary receiving purposes and
not for transmitting or broadcasting. The occupants
of house 446 Hart Road are a German couple, namely,
Mr. and Mrs. P.G. BREUER. Mr. BREUER is employed
by Kunst and Albers, 110 Szechuen Road.

FILE

Logan
D. S. I.

D. C.(Special Branch).

Sent, 30/8.

（印：INDEXED BY (S.B.) REGISTRY DATE 31/ 8 /40）

报告
日期：1940年8月30日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别巡捕房档案室 档案号 337）

事由：赫德路442至450号房屋内的无线电发射活动。

由副督察长洛根（Logan）撰写并呈送

兹就附上的美国海军陆战队来函提及在赫德路442至450号建筑物屋顶架设无线电天线一事，经观察显示，该天线由竹竿支撑，高出建筑物顶部约15英尺，天线的中间有两根引入线绞合在一起，并连接至赫德路446号。所获情报表明，该天线系用于普通接收目的，而非用于发射或广播。赫德路446号的住户为一对德国夫妇，即P.G. 布鲁尔（BREUER）先生及夫人。布鲁尔先生受雇于四川路110号的孔士洋行（Kunst and Albers）。

存档

洛根
副督察长

特别巡捕房副总监。

发送，8月30日。

（印：由特别巡捕房档案室索引编制 日期 1940年8月31日）

UNITED STATES MARINE CORPS
HEADQUARTERS, FOURTH MARINES,
SHANGHAI, CHINA.

28 August 1940

Mr. J. Mason
Special Branch
Shanghai Municipal Police
185 Foochow Road

Dear Mr. Mason:-

Recent repairs have been made to a radio
aerial on the roof of a building (442 to 450 Hart Road)
adjoining this compound.

It would be appreciated if you would
have an investigation made of this installation as it
is possible that it may be a short-wave transmitting
station.

Yours very truly,

R. E. HONSOWETZ
1st-Lieut., USMC

（批：C.O.S. Kirk
Perhaps Clive Wong or
S.S.D. may have some
information on above.
W.J.S 8/8
Luzg8）

尊敬的梅森先生：

近期，毗邻本营区的一栋建筑物（赫德路442至450号）屋顶的无线电天线进行了维修。

如蒙贵方对该设施进行调查，不胜感激，因为它可能是一个短波发射台。

此致

敬礼

R. E. 洪索韦茨（HONSOWETZ）
美国海军陆战队中尉
